messages:
maria_marketing: Heads-up — for next Tue's webinar we need live captions + post-event translated subtitle files (EN, ES, FR). Can we confirm Zoom settings and who owns the transcript QA?

sam_ops: I can toggle live captions in the Zoom advanced settings. Do we want auto-captions only or Otter/3rd-party for better verbatim?

maria_marketing: Prefer Otter for host accuracy (legal likes verbatim). But Otter needs an account and cloud recording enabled. Ash — can Growth cover Otter seats?

ash_growth: We have 1 spare Otter seat on the growth account, can provision it to "webinars@redwood.com" today. Will that work?

lee_speaker: Quick note — I'll refer to internal code names and a demo script. Otter sometimes mangles acronyms, can we add a short glossary to the transcript before publishing?

ben_prod: Good call. After recording we can run a small postproc step: replace acronyms using a glossary map and produce SRT/WEBVTT. I can write a tiny script.

video_team_bot: zoom-bot: recording scheduled for 2025-11-03T17:00:00Z, cloud recording enabled, live transcription: disabled (waiting on Otter link).

sam_ops: Steps: 1) ash gets Otter seat provisioned 2) sam links Otter to webinar zoom account 3) enable cloud recording + auto-assign host to start Otter 4) ben runs postproc -> generate EN SRT, then translate.

ash_growth: Otter seat provisioned and assigned to "webinars@redwood.com". Share credentials securely? (I'll drop in 1Password). :lock:

maria_marketing: Perfect. For translations — do we want vendor human edit for ES/FR or machine translate then quick QA? Budget check?

ash_growth: Machine translate + quick QA by contract transcribers is the sweet spot. We have $400 budget for this episode.

ben_prod: Will set up pipeline: input = Otter JSON -> glossary corrections -> EN SRT/WEBVTT -> send to translate API (DeepL) -> produce ES/FR SRTs -> mark for QA. I’ll attach a PR with the script after the run.

lee_speaker: Also please timestamp demo clip markers in the recording for marketing to cut highlights. I usually cue with "DEMO START" verbally.

maria_marketing: Great — marketing will create highlight requests in Asana after ben posts timestamps. For post-event follow-up: draft email should link to on-demand replay (hosted on S3), English captions visible by default, language selector for subtitles.

sam_ops: Hosting flow: cloud recording -> export master MP4 -> transcode via lambda -> upload to s3-public/replays/<slug> -> generate player page with language options. I'll add lifecycle tags.

video_team_bot: deploy-bot: CDN invalidation scheduled after upload.

maria_marketing: Timeline check — recording happens Tue 17:00Z, expect master MP4 by Tue 18:30Z, captions + postproc by Wed 02:00Z, translated SRTs + QA by Wed 12:00Z, marketing email Wed 16:00Z. Any blockers?

ash_growth: None from OTTER side. 1Password note sent.

ben_prod: I’ll run a dry-run on a 10-min test clip today to validate the pipeline and post the logs here.

lee_speaker: Thanks all — extra ask: can we include a short speaker bio card for the player UI? maria_marketing will share assets.

maria_marketing: Will do. I’ll post the final checklist and Asana tasks once ben confirms the test pass. :party_popper:
